reviews.title: perfect fit for an acer laptop old school.
reviews.comment:
if your not worried about speed or size. This worked great in my old school Acer laptop. put windows 10 OS on it and the speed seemed reasonable. faster than the HD that was in it..  As far as speed for gameing i dont know didnt use it for that..  but for general booting and moving a few files here and there the speed was excellent. Quality remains to be seen. I usually use a drive till its dead so it should last a few years. Easy installation. worked right out of the box.
If you need a quick drive that doesnt take up much space this ones for you. im using it with a laptop and older processor so for gaming im not sure about the speed. But for every day use works great.

reviews.title: Won’t Work on a Raspberry PI Great Value for other Use Cases
reviews.comment:
For the price this is a fantastic SSD - IF you’re running it on a PC.  This worked once on. Raspberry PI via a SSD hat for a brief second never to work again on the PI except to hang loading the OS via a USB/SSD stick It connects nicely to windows and Linux on the PC.
Most likely a PCI latency issue ~ the stick is just too slow for the PI’s picky configuration.  So blame it on the stick or blame it on the PI but either way gotta pay $30 more for a brand name that has higher mountability with Pi
